//: The operator tools in scripts/, typechecked separately from the app. They are excluded from tsconfig.json because `next build` typechecks whatever that file includes, and two of them import `playwright` — a tool for taking screenshots on a laptop, not something the deployed app should carry. Keeping them out of the build and checked here means a broken script is still caught by `npm run typecheck`, without a browser automation library becoming a production dependency. Needs playwright present: `npm i -D playwright`.
